releases.title: Update checker
notes: The server console now says on start whether a newer version of Petrel is out.
Set pigeon_update_check to quiet or off in server.cfg to change it.

releases.title: First release
notes: Cartridge bays, two probes that both have to land, visible wires, re-energizing and drive stun.
A server-enforced exposure limit, evidence items and a firing log with /taserlog.
Five HUD styles players can choose from, a safety switch, dual lasers and a weapon light.
Qbox, QBCore, ESX or standalone, most inventories, in 15 languages.
